name: azure
description: Manage Azure and Entra ID from Claude. 91 tools, full read and write, using your existing az login.
long_description:
Read and operate Microsoft Azure and Entra ID through your own account.

Authentication uses the Azure CLI session already on your machine, so there is no key to paste and no secret stored in the bundle. A service principal can be configured instead when you need an unattended identity.

Coverage spans the resource plane and the directory. Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, Key Vault, monitoring, cost, and security all have dedicated tools, with ARM_GET and ARM_Request as escape hatches for anything not covered. Graph_GET and Graph_Request reach past the resource boundary into Entra ID, app registrations, Conditional Access, and Intune device management.

Writes are real: start and stop virtual machines, web apps, and AKS clusters; resize and tag resources; create and delete resource groups; set Key Vault secrets; and issue arbitrary ARM or Graph calls. Every operation is bounded by the RBAC and Graph permissions of the signed-in identity. The server grants nothing on its own and cannot exceed what you can already do.

Runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Windows has no az.exe, so the bundle resolves the Azure CLI's own interpreter rather than spawning a shell.

azure_subscription_id.title: Subscription ID (optional)
azure_subscription_id.description: Default subscription so tools can omit subscription_id. Otherwise the az default subscription is used.

azure_tenant_id.title: Tenant ID (optional)
azure_tenant_id.description: Entra tenant id. Required only for service principal auth; with Azure CLI auth it selects the tenant for tokens.

azure_client_id.title: Service Principal Client ID (optional)
azure_client_id.description: App registration client id. Leave empty to use your existing `az login` session instead.

azure_client_secret.title: Service Principal Client Secret (optional)
azure_client_secret.description: Client secret for the service principal. Stored in the OS keychain. Leave empty to use `az login`.

az_path.title: Path to az binary (optional)
az_path.description: Absolute path to the Azure CLI if it is not on PATH (common when launched by a desktop app), e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/az.

tools.name: Delete_Resource_Group

tools.name: Delete_Resource

tools.name: Set_Key_Vault_Secret
tools.description: Create or update a secret in a key vault. Requires data-plane write access.

tools.name: ARM_GET
tools.description: Perform a read-only GET against any Azure Resource Manager path (GET only; no writes).

tools.name: ARM_Request
tools.description: Escape hatch: perform a write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) against any Azure Resource Manager path. Use the specific tools when one exists.
